howItWorks.title: How It Works — Buying a Used Car from China
howItWorks.description: How to find, request, confirm and export a used vehicle from China: search, select, request a quote, confirm and export.
howItWorks.intro: A straightforward process for finding and exporting a used vehicle from China.

steps.title: Search
steps.text: Browse our available inventory and filter by brand, model, year, price, mileage and body type.

steps.title: Select
steps.text: Choose a vehicle, or tell us your requirements and we will source options from China's market.

steps.title: Request a Quote
steps.text: Send us the vehicle details or your requirements and receive a quote for the vehicle.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.text: Confirm the vehicle, configuration and shipping arrangement for your destination.

steps.title: Export
steps.text: We coordinate export preparation and documentation for shipment from China.

areas.title: Vehicle Sourcing
areas.text: We source vehicles from China's domestic market, including petrol, hybrid and electric models. If a specific vehicle is not in our current inventory, we can look for it on request.

areas.title: Inspection
areas.text: We provide the vehicle information we hold — specifications, mileage and condition details as supplied by the source. Where data is not available, we say so rather than guessing.

areas.title: Documentation
areas.text: We help prepare the export documentation your market requires. Requirements vary by destination country, so we confirm these with you during the quote.

areas.title: Shipping
areas.text: We can help coordinate shipping to your destination port. Freight, insurance, taxes and duties depend on the destination and are quoted separately.

faqs.question: Do you ship vehicles to my country?
faqs.answer: We can help coordinate export and shipping to many destinations. Final shipping availability and cost depend on your destination port, so please contact us with your location.

faqs.question: Can you source a vehicle that is not in your inventory?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tell us the brand, model, year, budget and destination using the Request a Car form, and we will look for options in China's market.

faqs.question: What does the listed price include?
faqs.answer: The listed price is the asking price for the vehicle only. Shipping, taxes, import duties and other landed costs are quoted separately and depend on the destination.

faqs.question: How long does export take?
faqs.answer: Export time depends on the vehicle, documentation requirements and destination. We confirm an estimated timeline when you request a quote.

faqs.answer: Yes. Browse our available inventory or use the Request a Car form to describe what you need, and we can help source it from China's domestic market. Final availability depends on your destination.

faqs.question: Do you only sell vehicles already in your inventory?
faqs.answer: No. We also source vehicles on request. Tell us the brand, model, year, budget and destination, and we will look for options in China's market.

faqs.question: What does the listed price include?
faqs.answer: The listed price is the asking price for the vehicle. Shipping, taxes, import duties and other landed costs are quoted separately and depend on your destination.

faqs.question: How do I get an export quote?
faqs.answer: Request a quote from any vehicle page, or use the Request a Car form. We respond by email or WhatsApp with availability, price and export information.

about.title: About — China Used Car Export
about.description: China Used Car Export is a commercial platform for sourcing used and near-new vehicles from China for export buyers.
paragraphs: China Used Auto Hub is a commercial platform for sourcing used and near-new vehicles from China's domestic market for export. We help overseas dealers, importers, wholesalers and professional buyers find vehicles, compare specifications, request quotes and source specific vehicles.

Our focus is on vehicle sourcing and export — displaying available inventory, capturing sourcing requirements, and helping coordinate export preparation and shipping. Vehicle specifications and data are published alongside our listings, with a planned expansion into dedicated Data, Market and Tools resources.

We publish only the vehicle information we hold. Where a detail is not available, we say so rather than guessing. We do not publish sales figures, customer counts, certifications or rankings that we cannot substantiate.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy — China Used Car Export
privacy.description: Privacy policy for China Used Car Export — how we handle the information you submit through our enquiry forms.
privacy.intro: This policy explains how {siteName} handles information you provide when you use this website, including enquiry and request forms.

p: When you submit a quote or sourcing request, we collect the details you provide — such as your name, email, WhatsApp number, company, and the vehicle requirements you describe. We only use this to respond to your enquiry.
We use your information solely to respond to your enquiry and to provide the sourcing and export services you request. We do not sell your information or share it with third parties for marketing.
